subject: general
concept: Indian Geography, Government Policies and Schemes
question: Which one of the following programmes is associated with the development of road transport in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Golden Quadrilateral**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Golden Quadrilateral** is a national highway system in India that connects most of the country's major economic, agricultural, and cultural centres.
 
• It forms a quadrilateral that connects India's four largest metro cities: **Delhi (north), Kolkata (East), Mumbai (west), and Chennai (central) (south)**.
 
• The main goal of these super roads is to cut travel time and distance between India's four megacities.
 
• The project was planned in **1999** and launched in **2001**.
 
• **The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI),** which is part of the Ministry of Road, Transport, and Highways, oversees the Golden Quadrilateral project.
 
• Although safety elements like guardrails, shoulders and high-visibility signage are used, the vast majority of the system is not access restricted. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** is a job-guarantee programme in India that was enacted into law on **August 25, 2005**.
 
• Adult members of any rural household willing to conduct public work-related unskilled manual work at the statutory minimum salary of Rs. 120 are legally guaranteed one hundred days of employment every financial year under the scheme.
 
• This legislation was enacted with the goal of increasing rural people's purchasing power by providing largely semi- or un-skilled work to those living in rural India, whether or not they are poor.
 
• The law was formerly known as the **National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA), **but on October 2, 2009, it was renamed.
 
• **The National Rural Health Mission (NRHM)** was established on April 12, 2005, with the goal of providing rural populations, particularly vulnerable groups, with accessible, cheap, and high-quality health care.
